title: #thisismyfavoritesong #francescaduva #playwrightshorizons #favoriteso...
transcript: Last night, I went to a solo show at Playwrights Horizons called This Is My Favorite Song by Francesca D’Uva. What starts as your standard comedy set quickly unfolds into something much more unhinged and varied in both form and tone. Using her father's passing in 2020 from Covid as the main throughline, Francesca discusses a plethora of different topics, most of which are accompanied by an original song. The show is full of hilarious pop bangers such as “Kindergarten Nativity Scene” for example. I thought this was a fantastic performance — there's like an art to the way Francesca delivers her material. It’s not really a series of setups leading to punchlines but rather a consistently funny pot of jokes brewing with some jokes that come out of left field unexpectedly and like really catch you off guard in the best way. I would definitely recommend checking out this show which is running through December 8th. With that, another program for my collection.
